card.name: Words leading into negative descriptors
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation just before a harsh or negative adjective or noun, such as 'most' before 'vile' or 'or' before 'violent'. Seen in web text about wicked, dubious or violent people and things.

modes.label: Intensifier before insult
modes.description: Words like 'most' or 'plainly' placed right before a condemning adjective.
modes.example: allmost uniformly some of the<< most>> vile & despicable people I have ever

modes.label: Comma or 'or' in lists of bad traits
modes.description: A comma or 'or' inside a list of negative qualities, where another negative term comes next.
modes.example: acting aggressive, being angry<< or>> violent acting on dangerous

modes.label: Verb before negative judgment
modes.description: A verb such as 'are' or 'appears' that leads into a negative label like lying or gullible.
modes.example: he in fact<< appears>> gullible and stupid to anyone who

card.writes: It pushes up harsh, violent or negative descriptive words and pushes down unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a nasty or condemning description is about to come.
